title: Shooting ZOE
subtitle: Ludwigburg, Stuttgart
content: 'Zoe' was shot around Stuttgart and Ludwigsburg together with Mandy Fabian, Béla Can Leon and director of photography Anian Krone with the support of Profi-Wash in Schwieberdingen. In November 2023 'Zoe' took part at the competition program of the up-and-coming film festival Hannover and was screened at exground filmfestival in Wiesbaden and Caminhos Filmfestival in Portugal.
